email.body1:
Philo, saw IntelAgree keeps building out Saige Assist and has grown the team to around 92.

Growth at that pace usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for IntelAgree off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Philo, quick follow-up for IntelAgree.

As CRO, you feel the pipeline target outrun headcount faster than anyone. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings IntelAgree needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Philo, last bit of proof for IntelAgree.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how IntelAgree's reply rate likely compares to other contract-intelligence software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
